483ea8d36eab.title: Early Career Product Engineer
483ea8d36eab.description_html:
About Bridger

Bridger is building the AI automation platform for professional services. We are a full-stack AI company: we own the entire service delivery stack, allowing us to capture the true potential of AI faster and significantly expand our TAM compared to traditional AI SaaS products.

Our team consists of a product division (developing our proprietary AI platform) and a services division (managing and delivering services to our clients). Our critical advantage vs. traditional AI SaaS companies is our control, access, flexibility, and rapid iteration required to fundamentally reimagine and automate complex professional workflows.

Today, we serve thousands of clients. Since earlier this year, we’ve expanded our team by 10x and grown revenue from zero to millions. We’re backed by world-class VCs and institutional investors that have built multibillion-dollar platforms.

About the Role

We're looking for a talented product engineer to join us in building our shared technology platform. This is a broad role encompassing full stack development, as well as developing AI agents for workflow automation.
Join us if the following excites you:

  • Being on the cutting edge of technology: We are pushing the bounds of AI agents in real, production workflows. This is exciting, but difficult, and will require learning together

  • Working with end users: You will literally be sitting next to your users, and partnering with them to help make their lives easier

  • Working in-person in our NYC office

About you

  • You love to build, and are excited to work in a scrappy, ambiguous environment

  • You take ownership of your work and are eager to grow into driving projects from conception to production

  • You have empathy to work with operational teams and understand their needs

  • You have experience with modern front-end frameworks (React, TypeScript, Next.js, etc.), through coursework, internships, or professional experience

  • You have 0-2 years of engineering experience

Compensation & Benefits
For this role, the salary range is $150,000 to $200,000. Actual compensation will vary based on skills, experience, and seniority.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Unlimited PTO and wellness benefits

  • 401(k) with company matching

  • Equity determined by level and experience

  • Grow into the leader you aspire to be. At a fast-growing company at the forefront of AI transformation, you can enjoy unmatched career growth.

Are you looking for a hands-on internship that puts you at the heart of real-world engineering challenges? Join us as a Civil or Environmental Engineering Intern in Green Bay, WI for Summer 2027 and gain experience working on projects in solid waste management. From observing landfill construction to assisting with regulatory efforts, you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals and have a direct impact on contributing to a positive environmental impact. This is your opportunity to build skills, make connections, and see your work come to life!

Primary Responsibilities:

Conduct landfill construction observation  Participate in waste characterization studies  Assist with the design of landfills, transfer stations, and recycling facilities  Assist with data analysis and regulatory reporting  Gain exposure to solid waste planning, including waste diversion and recycling  Support other project work as assigned 

Required Qualifications:

Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering or a related field from an ABET-accredited program  All Foth Companies are equal opportunity employers, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified women, minorities, persons with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.
